elements.expression:
markdown "# XML Insight Lab — Executive Canvas Workpad (100% Custom CSS)

**[00. Return to Home Portal](/app/dashboards#/view/xml-insight-home)** · **Elastic Stack 8.17.4 · Config-Driven Logstash Error Mapping Engine (`error_mapping.yaml`) · Live Canvas ESSQL Telemetry**"
| render css=".canvasRenderEl { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e1b4b 0%, #312e81 55%, #4c1d95 100%); border: 1px solid #6366f1; border-left: 5px solid #38bdf8; border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px 24px; color: #f8fafc; box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); } .canvasRenderEl h1 { color: #38bdf8; font-size: 22px; margin: 0 0 8px 0; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.3px; } .canvasRenderEl p { color: #e0e7ff; font-size: 13px; margin: 0; } .canvasRenderEl a { display: inline-block; background: #0f172a; border: 1px solid #38bdf8; border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 10px; color: #38bdf8 !important; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }"

essql query="SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM \"xml-insight-runs-v1*\""
| math "cnt"
| metric "Total XML Test Runs" metricFont={font size=44 family="Inter, sans-serif" color="#38bdf8" align="center" weight="bold"} labelFont={font size=14 family="Inter, sans-serif" color="#cbd5e1" align="center" weight="bold"}
| render css=".canvasRenderEl { background: linear-gradient(145deg, #1e293b, #0f172a); border: 1px solid #38bdf8; border-radius: 14px; padding: 18px; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); }"

essql query="SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM \"xml-insight-testcases-v1*\" WHERE phase = 'suite' AND normalized_result IN ('FAILED', 'ERROR')"
| math "cnt"
| metric "Failed Suite TestCases" metricFont={font size=44 family="Inter, sans-serif" color="#f87171" align="center" weight="bold"} labelFont={font size=14 family="Inter, sans-serif" color="#fecaca" align="center" weight="bold"}
| render css=".canvasRenderEl { background: linear-gradient(145deg, #450a0a, #1e1b4b); border: 1px solid #ef4444; border-radius: 14px; padding: 18px; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); }"

essql query="SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM \"xml-insight-testcases-v1*\" WHERE phase = 'suite' AND error_mapping.disposition = 'RELEVANT'"
| math "cnt"
| metric "Actionable RELEVANT Faults" metricFont={font size=44 family="Inter, sans-serif" color="#fbbf24" align="center" weight="bold"} labelFont={font size=14 family="Inter, sans-serif" color="#fde68a" align="center" weight="bold"}
| render css=".canvasRenderEl { background: linear-gradient(145deg, #451a03, #0f172a); border: 1px solid #f59e0b; border-radius: 14px; padding: 18px; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); }"

essql query="SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM \"xml-insight-plan-status-v1*\" WHERE suite_completeness = 'COMPLETE'"
| math "cnt"
| metric "Complete Nightly Plan Slots" metricFont={font size=44 family="Inter, sans-serif" color="#34d399" align="center" weight="bold"} labelFont={font size=14 family="Inter, sans-serif" color="#a7f3d0" align="center" weight="bold"}
| render css=".canvasRenderEl { background: linear-gradient(145deg, #022c22, #0f172a); border: 1px solid #10b981; border-radius: 14px; padding: 18px; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); }"

essql query="SELECT \"test_bench.id\" AS Bench, \"error_mapping.category\" AS Category, COUNT(*) AS Failures FROM \"xml-insight-testcases-v1*\" WHERE phase = 'suite' AND \"error_mapping.category\" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY \"test_bench.id\", \"error_mapping.category\""
| pointseries x="Bench" y="Failures" color="Category"
| plot defaultStyle={seriesStyle bars=0.55} legend="ne" xaxis={axisConfig position="bottom"} yaxis={axisConfig position="left"} font={font size=12 family="Inter, sans-serif" color="#e2e8f0"}
| render css=".canvasRenderEl { background: #1e293b; border: 1px solid #6366f1; border-radius: 14px; padding: 18px; }"
